metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for working on EHOS, the components around it, and the applications built on it.

plugins.name: ehos-core
plugins.description: The way of working every EHOS repository and every application built on EHOS shares, beside the plugin of its domain (T-33): plan a piece of work by the outcome, the outside judge that shows it and what is expected, and look back on finished work to send each lesson to whoever can fix it, keeping a private repository's code private.

plugins.name: ehos-dev
plugins.description: Skills shared by eh-os, ehos-tools and ehos_contract: how a changelog line is written and a component released (eh-os D-91), how a planned piece of work is run through a GitHub issue, how a repository's open follow-ups are triaged against the code, how a change is reviewed before its pull request, how its description is written and it is opened, from the template every EHOS repository and application shares, how a decision record is written in eh-os and ehos-tools, how eh-os's architecture is kept current with a change, how Elixir and its tests are written in the three and reviewed for its anti-patterns, and how any text a person reads about EHOS is written, in the docs and the console: the sentence rules of ASD-STE100 and the words of the glossary of the component that owns each word; and how a diagram in that documentation is drawn and generated with ehos_diagrams (eh-os D-107).

plugins.name: ehos-app
plugins.description: Skills for working on an application built on EHOS, which ehos_app's template enables in every project it generates: plan a change, ship it to a ready pull request, review your own change and record it for the review gate before its pull request opens, write its description from the template every EHOS repository and application shares and open it, review a branch through the application's lenses (its contracts, credentials, ehos.yaml, migrations), write Elixir and its tests as the template's rules say, review Elixir for anti-patterns, draft the sample data an ephemeral environment's seed records through the contracts, and look back on finished work to file the platform's defects it met where they can be fixed.

plugins.name: diagram-design
plugins.description: Cathryn Lavery's diagram-design (MIT), version 2.6.64, pinned to a commit: the method the ehos-dev:diagrams skill lays a diagram out with. Listed here so that eh-os, ehos-tools and ehos_contract use one version of it.
